name: Dānshēn Dàshī
source:
“Single Forever?” is a choice-driven Visual Novel where the player plays as the Cupid to matchmake their client through comparing stats and giving out guidance.

In this game, you'll step into the shoes of Red, an intern Cupid, tasked with a hellish mission to keep their job: help the love-resistant heroine, Lia, find her first love!

Lia is a 29-year-old young woman—sweet, cheerful, and always ready for love... but despite her best efforts, she's never been in a relationship. Why is she still single after all this time?

As Red, you'll need to navigate the chaotic world of modern dating, help Lia break out of her comfort zone, and guide her toward the love she’s been waiting for.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3545460/Single_Forever/]Steam[/url]]
